title: Soundness of the two-tape table reader
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb N$, bit string $x$, transition table $t$ on states $0,\ldots,n$ and the three possible scanned symbols on the input tape and each of two work tapes, and suffix $r$, if the table reader with parameter $n$ applied to $x$ returns $(t,r)$, then $x$ is the serialization of $t$ followed by $r$. The serialization lists the actions in state and scanned-symbol order, with each action recording the input-head movement, both work-tape writes and movements, the optional output bit, and the optional successor state.
hypotheses_covered: A transition table t of the specified type
The table reader succeeds on x and returns (t,r)
